hero.title: File:Battle between Novgorod and Suzdal.jpg
hero.source: Battle between Novgorod and Suzdal in 1170
hero.description:
It is probably in the church of St. Demetrius in Kozhevniki; in the XIX century, moved to the chapel of St. Varlaam Khutynsky, and later - in the Church of St. Nicholas Kochanov Received Novgorod diocesan Drevlekhranilishche in 1912
Restored in 1913 by PI in Novgorod Yukina; in 1957 GTSHRM AN Riabinina
hero.dateCreated: Middle - second half of the XV century
